why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items. It has exactly two checks, one for each expect line: Check 1 compares the CSV and TSV outputs, and Check 2 greps README.md for --tsv. Neither PASS nor FAIL condition requires npm test or the CSV tests to pass. Check 1's PASS needs only "SAME" plus the expected JSON array. Check 2's PASS needs only a grep match that describes the flag. The verifier brief does mention npm test, but only under "Advisory (not a pass or fail condition)", which asks the verifier to note results without gating on them. I don't count that as a third check, though it is a borderline call. The builder brief also runs npm test, but the must_not items are about the verifier's checks and conditions, so that doesn't break the criterion. Neither must_not item is violated.
